A tester asked: After picking a genre for an artist, a button to confirm it, so it is clear the choice was saved.

What changed: The tier, tag and genre picker now has a Done button. Swiping it away still saves too.

A tester asked: Google sign-in did nothing after installing Vagus from Google Play.

What changed: Fixed the same day on our side, with no app update needed. Vagus now also says so when sign-in fails.
